input.initial_pose: Saved one-time mocap SLERP alignment at the first actual gyro sample
input.torque: Frozen refined actuator torque plus strictly past residual mean once; torque_applied_body is diagnostic only
input.reference_semantics: Mocap pose and SG-derived omega are read-only; raw gyro is a noisy measured reference, not angular-velocity truth
input.requested_time_semantics: Native times copied verbatim; no requested periodic grid
input.initial_reading_role: Initial N(W0;y0,R) once; each later native reading one likelihood

nonlinear.posterior: initial N(W0;y0,R) times ALL acquired j>=1 multivariate Student-t gyro likelihoods once
nonlinear.refresh_nodes_reconstruction: existing gaussian_tensor_points(refresh mean, covariance, order); no redundant per-observation node tensor
nonlinear.initial_law: Same Gaussian N(W0;y0,R) as the previous experiment; y0 initializes once
nonlinear.marginalization: Gamma observation precision integrated analytically in every Student-t factor
nonlinear.observation_covariance_meaning: R is marginal covariance; Student-t scale Sigma=(nu-2)/nu R

event_side_meaning.0: physical prediction without a new observation

dense_output.posterior_target: original N(W0;y0,R) times every likelihood through last included acquisition, divided by the same causal numerical proposal
dense_output.numerical_integration_note: Dense query times split RK4 intervals after the same causal proposal anchor; finite RK4 differences are not changes to the posterior law or saved observation rows.

linear_forced.posterior: initial N(W0;y0,R) times ALL acquired j>=1 multivariate Student-t gyro likelihoods once
linear_forced.refresh_nodes_reconstruction: existing gaussian_tensor_points(refresh mean, covariance, order); no redundant per-observation node tensor
linear_forced.initial_law: Same Gaussian N(W0;y0,R) as the previous experiment; y0 initializes once
linear_forced.marginalization: Gamma observation precision integrated analytically in every Student-t factor
linear_forced.observation_covariance_meaning: R is marginal covariance; Student-t scale Sigma=(nu-2)/nu R

event_side_meaning.0: physical prediction without a new observation

dense_output.posterior_target: original N(W0;y0,R) times every likelihood through last included acquisition, divided by the same causal numerical proposal
dense_output.numerical_integration_note: Dense query times split RK4 intervals after the same causal proposal anchor; finite RK4 differences are not changes to the posterior law or saved observation rows.

model_difference: omega cross(J omega) only; same refined inertia, frozen torque and quaternion kinematics
state_model: Q=0, initial N(W0;y0,R) times all acquired Student-t likelihoods once
